crossRefs.note: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you. You will be witnesses to me in Jerusalem, in all…
But when Silas and Timothy came down from Macedonia, Paul was compelled by the Spirit, testifying to the Jews that…
testifying both to Jews and to Greeks repentance toward God, and faith toward our Lord Jesus.
Having therefore obtained the help that is from God, I stand to this day testifying both to small and great, saying…
how the Christ must suffer, and how, by the resurrection of the dead, he would be first to proclaim light both to these…
When they had appointed him a day, many people came to him at his lodging. He explained to them, testifying about God’s…
“Be it known therefore to you, that the salvation of God is sent to the nations, and they will listen.”
preaching God’s Kingdom, and teaching the things concerning the Lord Jesus Christ with all boldness, without hindrance.
You will also testify, because you have been with me from the beginning.
Through Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I consider him, I have written to you briefly, exhorting, and testifying…
and sent messengers before his face. They went and entered into a village of the Samaritans, so as to prepare for him.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

people.name: Samaria
people.line: Capital city of the northern kingdom of Israel; Samaritan inhabitants

translations.web: They therefore, when they had testified and spoken the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the Good News to many villages of the Samaritans.
translations.bsb: And after Peter and John had testified and spoken the word of the Lord, they returned to Jerusalem, preaching the gospel in many of the Samaritan villages.
translations.kjv: And they, when they had testified and preached the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the gospel in many villages of the Samaritans.
translations.asv: They therefore, when they had testified and spoken the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the gospel to many villages of the Samaritans.
